outputs.explanation: This is a stacked bar chart showing the median state frequency of promoters within each Pol II ChIP-seq bin (caption explicitly states 'the median frequency of each promoter state was calculated' and 'each bar...represents the median state frequencies of the promoters in the bin'). This is a bar chart of medians, which is not among the exempt plot types (box/violin, heatmap, line, pie/Venn, scatter), so individual per-promoter data points behind each bar's median should be shown but are not.

This panel is a single-molecule stack (heatmap-like) plot where each row already represents an individual DNA molecule's methylation pattern, so individual data points (molecules) are directly shown rather than only a summary average.

Same representation as panel A (stacked bar chart of median state frequencies per Pol II ChIP-seq bin for mouse promoters); it is a bar chart of medians without the underlying individual promoter data points shown.
Same representation as panel B; each row of the single-molecule stack is an individual molecule, so individual data points are already displayed.
This is a box plot, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement because it already conveys the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers).
